outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Royston is a civil parish and village situated within the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley, South Yorkshire. Located north of Barnsley town centre, the community developed significantly during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries alongside the local coal mining industry, evolving over the decades into an established residential settlement.

The area features notable open spaces, including Rabbit Ings Country Park, which was constructed on a former colliery site, as well as Royston Park near the centre of the village. Local facilities include Royston Leisure Centre, community services, and everyday shops located around High Street, alongside the historic parish Church of St John the Baptist. Primary healthcare services in the immediate area are supported by general practices including The Parks Medical Centre.

To support local healthcare needs, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic provides Pharmacy First consultations for eligible people from Royston. The Pharmacy First service covers certain common health conditions, allowing residents to access professional clinical advice. During a consultation, the pharmacist assesses symptoms, relevant medicines and medical history. The outcome may include advice, suitable treatment or referral to another healthcare professional, though eligibility and treatment depend on individual clinical assessment.
outputCopy.relationshipToPharmacy: Consultations take place at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield. Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic is approximately 8.8 km in a straight line from Royston.
